main_text.p: étes ; at liqua forte in Pauli manum inciderit, in ignem inulta excutitur. Nemo minus fugiat noxium animal, quòd incolumem Apoftolum intuetur ; Pariter fe habet fideli peccatum. Symbolum eft Ioannis, Peccatum omne ἁμαρτία: Symbolum Pauli, ὁλοθρία peccati mors. Conijciantur hæc duo ; naturalis peccati venia euanescit. Rhemenses noftri (acuti homines) conuerfionem propofitionis non minùs ferunt, quàm fuam : Eft quidem (inquiunt) omne peccatum ἁμαρτία, fed non omnis ἁμαρτία peccatum. Conuertit ergo ipfemet Apoftolus πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει. Omnis 1 Io. 3. 4. Rom. 6. In 1 Io. 3. autem

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are partly faint and show-through; the Greek words in the text are printed in small type and are transcribed as best read. The note "In 1 Io. 3." and the Greek words are doubtful. The lower-left marginal stamp "copia" is omitted. Right margin faint show-through text is omitted.
